name: Thomaskerk
description: The Thomaskerk at Prinses Irenestraat 34 in Amsterdam-Zuid is a Protestant church designed by Karel Sijmons and built in 1966. A cluster of pale brick volumes with a curved, ribbon-windowed front, it is a sober building laid out entirely for Protestant worship, inspired by the curved roof of Le Corbusier's chapel at Ronchamp.
funFact: Inside, the sandstone floor recalls the Israelites' journey through the desert, the undulating roof stands for the sea, and twelve square window panes refer to the apostles.
